addr: No 42, 3rd floor, Above PC chandra, Koramangala 6th block extension, 100 Feet Rd, near Sony Signal, beside Bank of Boroda, Koramangala, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560095, India

rev.t: We recently visited Active Grid Koramangala for our team outing, and honestly, this place turned out to be such a hidden gem! I’m actually surprised that more people haven’t discovered this place yet. …

Had a wonderful experience. Time well spent with five different games, all the games were unique. Highly recommended for friends and family. The staffs are very understanding and sportive. Over all a budget friendly activity.

Ok firstly, the place is in 3rd floor of the PC chandra jewellers building. They dont have any big boards so its a bit difficult to spot. We can park 2 wheeler in basement, no idea about 4 wheelers tho. …
